author: breadtai
quote: There are games that are fun, games that are optimized and games with an inspiring plot. GTA VI may be entertaining, but so far lacks any resemblance of the other two criteria. Locked at 30fps and buggy, GTA VI’s ratings from critics has seemingly relied solely on hype and Rockstar’s notoriety. It may be a fun game, but for critics to have provided such a high rating it has surpassed a masterpiece like OoT is beyond farfetched. Overall based off of performance and lack of an inspiring plot so far, I will give this a low rating. Subject to change.

author: breadtai
quote: A sheer masterpiece that’s stood the test of time and revolutionized gaming to what we know today. Fun, optimized and most of all, a beautiful plot. Truly a must play for anyone.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (1998)
